name: GradientStops
description: Contains a collection of GradientStop objects.
remarks: Gradients are a smooth transition from one color state to another. The endpoints of these sections are called stops.
example:
Sub gradients()
 Set myDocument = ActivePresentation.Slides(1)
 Set GradientShapeFill = myDocument.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 90, 90, 90, 80).Fill
 With GradientShapeFill
 .ForeColor.RGB = RGB(0, 128, 128)
 .OneColorGradient msoGradientHorizontal, 1, 1
 .GradientStops.Insert RGB(255, 0, 0), 0.25
 .GradientStops.Insert RGB(0, 255, 0), 0.5
 .GradientStops.Insert RGB(0, 0, 255), 0.75
 End With
End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Office application. When used with an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the GradientStops object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Gets a GradientStop object from a GradientStops collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the GradientStops collection. Read-only.
